title: cli-matrix-conformance: Create cli_matrix_conformance proptest locking down 6 sources-of-truth
description: Feature S-21. Master §33.3 says this proptest exists; it doesn't. The 6 sources (Command enum, VALID_COMMANDS, parse_args, run_from_env, HELP, agent_context JSON) all need to stay in lockstep. P1-8 bumps agent-context to 30/30; this bead locks the cross-reference so future drift is caught. Create crates/workspace_tests/tests/cli_matrix_conformance.rs with a proptest that for each token in VALID_COMMANDS: asserts it's a Command variant, asserts parse_args(&['velvet-ballistics', token, '--help']) returns Ok(Command::Help), asserts run_from_env dispatches it, asserts it's in args/constants.rs::HELP, asserts agent_context::commands() contains it. Wire in crates/workspace_tests/Cargo.toml. Depends on P1-8.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL keep Command enum, VALID_COMMANDS, parse_args, run_from_env, HELP, and agent_context in lockstep
THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the proptest on any drift between the 6 sources of truth

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL iterate VALID_COMMANDS, assert cross-references for all 6 sources, and pass

event_driven.trigger: WHEN any of the 6 sources drifts (e.g., a new command is added to Command enum but not to VALID_COMMANDS)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the proptest with a clear error message identifying the drift

unwanted.condition: IF a token is in VALID_COMMANDS but not in the Command enum
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently accept it; the proptest must fail with 'Token X is in VALID_COMMANDS but not in Command enum'
unwanted.because: Master §33.3: the 6 sources are the source of truth; drift is a bug

preconditions: All 6 sources of truth exist: Command enum, VALID_COMMANDS, parse_args, run_from_env, HELP, agent_context::commands()
postconditions: It passes on the current code
invariants: The 6 sources are mutually consistent; any future drift fails the proptest

happy: cli_matrix_conformance_proptest_passes: the proptest iterates 30 tokens from VALID_COMMANDS and asserts all 6 cross-references for each
cli_matrix_conformance_locked_down: a property of the proptest is that it locks down 30 tokens (not 22, not 31)
error: cli_matrix_conformance_fails_on_drift: a deliberate test that adds a token to VALID_COMMANDS without adding it to Command enum should fail the proptest (manual; verify by hand)
valid_commands_subset_of_command_enum: a CI check asserts that every token in VALID_COMMANDS corresponds to a Command variant
parse_args_unknown_token_returns_error: a CI check asserts that parse_args with a token not in VALID_COMMANDS returns Err, not Ok
edge: cli_matrix_conformance_handles_30_tokens: the proptest must handle 30 tokens in <1 second (it's a unit test, not an integration test)

patterns: Pattern: existing proptests in crates/workspace_tests/ (use as a template)
questions: Should the proptest use the proptest crate or a simple loop? (Spec: proptest, for fuzz-style coverage; if proptest isn't available, a simple for loop is fine.)

security_failures.failure: An attacker adds a malicious command to VALID_COMMANDS that bypasses the Command enum's validation
security_failures.prevention: The proptest asserts VALID_COMMANDS is a subset of Command variants

usability_failures.failure: Agent-context JSON lists 30 commands but the binary only implements 22

data_integrity_failures.failure: parse_args returns Ok(Command::Help) for a token that isn't actually a Help command (false positive)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: The proptest asserts parse_args(token) returns the matching Command variant, not just Ok

integration_failures.failure: The proptest is added but not wired in Cargo.toml, so it never runs
integration_failures.prevention: Wire it in crates/workspace_tests/Cargo.toml; verify with `cargo test --test cli_matrix_conformance`
